plugin.name: Network Tools
plugin.description: IP addresses, ping, DNS lookups, ports and saved Wi-Fi networks. Type “ip”, “ping”, “dns”, “port”, “wifi” or “tracert” in the main search.
command.subtitle: Network Tools
command.ip.title: IP Addresses
command.ip.keywords: network, ip address, public ip, mac address, gateway, wifi
command.ping.title: Ping
command.dns.title: DNS Lookup
command.port.title: Port Lookup
command.port.keywords: port, listening, netstat, process, open port
command.wifi.title: Saved Wi-Fi Networks
command.tracert.title: Trace Route
command.flushDNS.title: Flush DNS Cache
command.renewIP.title: Renew IP Address
pref.publicIP.title: Show public IP address
pref.publicIP.description: When you type “ip”, ask api.ipify.org (or ifconfig.me) for your public address. The answer is kept for 5 minutes; nothing is asked in the background.
pref.pingCount.title: Ping count
pref.pingCount.description: Echo requests sent by Ping, unless you ping continuously.

hint.tracert.title: Type a host to trace the route to
